changeLogMessages: Added support for the byte, short, bigInteger and bigDecimal model types (Full Numeric Type Support SEP): byte maps to sbyte, short to short, bigInteger to System.Numerics.BigInteger and bigDecimal to Amazon.Extensions.Numerics.BigDecimal, serialized without losing digits or scale.
AWSSDK.Core now depends on AWSSDK.Extensions.Numerics, which provides BigDecimal.

Breaking Change: The assembly now has AssemblyVersion 4.0.0.0 and AssemblyFileVersion 4.0.0.x. Version 4.0.0.2 shipped with 0.0.0.0 because the project was missing Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs, so the version from _sdk-versions.json was never applied.

Added Smithy RPC v2 CBOR support for the byte, short, bigInteger and bigDecimal types (Full Numeric Type Support SEP): byte and short as CBOR integers, bigInteger as a bignum (tags 2/3) and bigDecimal as a decimal fraction (tag 4) via the new CborWriterExtensions.WriteBigDecimal.
